text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: We were so close, weren't we?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...A beast fighting with its life on the 
line will bare its fangs even at a lion, 
is that it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, all that remains for next 
time is to overpower them before they can 
even bare their fangs."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The crime of baring one's fangs at the 
King must be atoned for. ...Trample them.
choice_data_list: That pride of yours is your strength.
That pride of yours is your strength.

Next time, let's give it everything we've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What is a king without demonstrating their 
majesty?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Before the King, all must bow prostrate. 
...Thus, I must make my presence known.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That the victor of this race is none other 
than Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Of course. I will not go easy on you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You too may exert yourself for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your efforts, poured out with every drop 
of your heart's blood. All of it shall 
become nourishment for me.
